visualReview.method: Actual view_image inspection of all8 required reference screenshots and all4 preserved Python-card screenshots, two at a time
visualReview.findings: Complete original titles and publisher credits readable on desktop/native-mobile fullscreen; only title/credit on new references; all4 original full Python programs clearly visible and no native captions over cards.

limitations: Chromium viewport emulation, not physical mobile/iOS Safari.
Only the four changed appendices play at 1x on desktop; no duplicate mobile plays or prior-batch media GETs.
Playback is muted; no human audio/ASR claim. Complete body preservation uses the baseline-SHA-bound full media receipts.
390px embedded video remains small; full reading is inspected in actual native fullscreen at 844×390 and article text.
Citation clicks prevent navigation; source verification is a separate record.
scope: Four batch-9 first appendices; derived pages, title/credit-only cards, 4 desktop 1x Python-card-to-reference endings and 4 native mobile fullscreen cases. No prior-batch media or old appendix proof.
